'''Grabow''' was a [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] who lived during the last [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Grabow trained as a healer among his clansmen on Kashyyyk, and after Kashyyyk was [[Battle of Kashyyyk/Legends|attacked]] by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Grabow tended to Wookiees and [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] who were injured during the fighting. Following the rise of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], Grabow was [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]], along with the majority of the populace of his [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]]. However, he later escaped and regained his freedom, and the Empire subsequently placed a [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] for his capture and return.<ref name="character sheet" /> Grabow was later among a group of agents who were hired by the [[Pyke Syndicate/Legends|Pyke Syndicate]] to track down the [[Nikto/Legends|Nikto]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Kaa'to Leeachos]] in the [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|depths]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="SoaBS">''[[Under a Black Sun]]''</ref>
